meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动将实验室数据集成到 Benchling
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常在 Benchling 中手动操作数据
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data integration with Benchling.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently manage Benchling data manually.

howto.what: 装了这个技能，Claude 就能通过 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作你 Benchling 平台上的注册实体（如 DNA、RNA 序列）、库存、电子实验记录、工作流和数据仓库。它会按照你的指令创建、更新、查询或归档数据。
howto.when: 当你说出「创建 DNA 序列」「查询库存」「更新实验记录」等与 Benchling 平台相关的操作指令时，Claude 会调用这个技能来帮你自动完成。

say.text: 查询所有库存容器，并列出它们的名称和位置。
say.note: Claude 会列出 inventory 中的容器信息。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can operate Benchling registry entities (DNA, RNA, proteins), inventory, ELN entries, workflows, and Data Warehouse via Python SDK or REST API. It creates, updates, queries, or archives data per your commands.
howto.when_en: Claude triggers this skill when you mention actions like 'create a DNA sequence', 'query inventory', or 'update an experiment entry' related to Benchling operations.

say_en.text: Create a DNA sequence named 'Plasmid A' with bases ATCG in Benchling.
say_en.note: Claude will call the SDK to create the sequence and return the result.

say_en.text: List all inventory containers and show their names and locations.
